hero.headline: Real-Time Production Management—From Planning to Payment
hero.subheadline: Collaborate on budgets, schedules, and deliverables in one workspace. No more tool-switching. No more version chaos. Just seamless production management for creative teams.

problem.headline: Scattered Tools Slow You Down
painPoints: Budgets in Excel. Schedules in Google Cal. Messages in Slack. Files in Dropbox. Proposals in PowerPoint.
Context-switching wastes time. Version confusion creates mistakes. Clients see outdated info.
What if your entire production lived in one place—with real-time sync?

solution.headline: One Platform. Every Stage of Production.
solution.description: MYLG brings planning, budgeting, scheduling, messaging, and delivery into a single real-time workspace. Your team stays aligned. Clients stay informed. You stay on top of every detail.
differentiators: Real-time collaboration (edits sync instantly across your team)
AI-assisted planning (Spellbooks turn scope into budgets and tasks)
Role-based permissions (clients see what they need, not your working drafts)
Built for production teams (events, content, creative agencies)

features.title: Real-Time Slide Collaboration
features.description: Google Slides-style editor inside MYLG. Multi-user editing, automatic thumbnails, deck versioning. Present or export to PDF/PPTX.

features.title: Advanced Calendar Scheduling
features.description: Time blocks, Focus Blocks, drag-drop scheduling. Multi-user overlap awareness with auto-stacking. Day/week/list views.

features.title: AI-Powered Budget Building
features.description: Paste project scope → get line-item budget (Budget Spellbook). Revisions, markup, contingency, tax. Export to PDF invoice or CSV.

features.title: Integrated Messaging
features.description: Project threads + direct messages. Reactions, edits, file attachments. Real-time sync via WebSocket.

features.title: Task Workflows with Review
features.description: Formal review process (submit → request changes → approve). Link tasks to budget items (track quote → build → invoice). Archive completed work.

features.title: HQ Financial Ledger
features.description: Track expenses across all projects. Import bank CSVs, categorize transactions. Recurring commitment detection, financial reports.

features.title: File Management & Galleries
features.description: Upload to CDN (CloudFront), organize by project. Create shareable client galleries. PDF-to-slide conversion for web viewing.

features.title: Smart Notifications
features.description: Get notified only when it matters (mentions, reviews, shares, failures). Activity audit trail separate from notifications (no spam).

faq.question: Can multiple people edit slides at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes. Each slide has its own real-time room (Yjs). Changes sync instantly without conflicts.

faq.question: How does the Budget Spellbook work?
faq.answer: Paste your project scope (event description, run-of-show, shopping list) and Spellbook generates line items with categories, quantities, and estimates. You review and adjust before applying.

faq.question: What's the difference between Focus Blocks and Time Blocks?
faq.answer: Time Blocks are scheduled task instances. Focus Blocks are container tasks that group multiple time blocks (e.g., 'Load-In' containing 10 sub-tasks). Focus Blocks show progress (3/10 complete).

faq.question: Can clients see internal working versions of decks?
faq.answer: No. Deck versions have role-based visibility. You can set a client-specific default that only shows approved slides.

faq.question: How does HQ Ledger work with projects?
faq.answer: HQ Ledger is org-level (tracks all expenses across projects). You import transactions via CSV, categorize them, and HQ shows recurring costs, reports, and invoices. Project budgets are separate (line-item estimates).

faq.question: What happens if I lose internet while editing?
faq.answer: Yjs stores edits in IndexedDB (local browser storage). When you reconnect, changes sync automatically.

faq.question: Can I export budgets to Excel?
faq.answer: Yes. Export to CSV for Excel/Sheets, or generate PDF invoices directly.

faq.question: How are notifications different from activity?
faq.answer: Notifications are rare, actionable events (mentions, review requests, shares, failures). Activity is a full audit trail (who edited what, when). Activity doesn't spam you with notifications for every autosave.

faq.question: Does MYLG work on mobile?
faq.answer: Web app is responsive (works on tablets/phones). Native apps planned for future release.
